Hovering in the liminal space between consciousness and drowsiness, the fabric of the night envelops me. My breath, now a tranquil rhythm, laboring under the weight of the hours that have slipped past. Tide after tide, they crash against the shores of my mind, etching stories into the permanence of thought. Fleeting glimpses of this universal ballet, the dance of logic and emotion.
